static_features: September 2026 OSM inventory used as an explicitly estimated static surrogate for this period; historical road changes are not reconstructed.
dynamic_features: Historical provider weather records plus date/hour-specific traffic estimates; not 8760 independent traffic observations.
flood_risk: Static mapped NOAH hazard exposure proxy, not observed hourly flooding.

calibration_split.note: Declare chronological, non-overlapping ISO dates within the study period. Weights, scales, class summaries and profiles are fitted on development only; tuning freezes search budgets; test is held out for the comparison. Unset boundaries block calibration and routing.
